title.en: AITI OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM AMENDMENT ORDER 2003

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-35_2003_E-AITI-OF-BRUNEI-DARUSSALAM-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2003.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam (Amendment~ Order, 2003 and shall commence on the same date as the date appointed for the commencement of the Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam Order, 2001 (S 39/2001). Amendment of First Schedule to S 39 of 2001.

The First Schedule to the Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam Order, 2001 is amended by deleting paragraph 1 and by substituting the following new paragraph therefor - "Appointment of Chairman and members.
